ge-gate.title: Phobos's GE time for a whole frame against a PSP-1000's, since #291
ge-gate.alt: Eight judged game scenes, each within 15 percent of the PSP-1000's frame time: from 12.69 percent faster (Super Monkey Ball) to 9.95 percent slower (Activision Hits' 3D menu), Chains of Olympus within 0.87 percent.
ge-gate.source_md: Each scene's GE time for its whole frame in Phobos against the owner's capture of the same scene on his PSP-1000, from the gate table in [part 115](https://github.com/pwnedbygary/phobos/blob/master/docs/psp-core.md) of docs/psp-core.md (#291). The shaded band is the 15% the timing has to stay within.

ge-list-time.title: One display list's GE time: a real PSP against Phobos's old model
ge-list-time.alt: Horizontal bars for five game scenes: a PSP-1000's GE took 4.46 to 29.6 milliseconds for a display list where Phobos's old model charged 0.59 to 6.24, four to twelve times less.
ge-list-time.source_md: Measured on 16 October 2026 with a GE profiler under custom firmware on a PSP-1000, against the time Phobos's model then charged for the same scenes' lists. Data from the repository's [docs/progress/data.json](https://github.com/pwnedbygary/phobos/blob/master/docs/progress/data.json). Since #269 the GE takes close to the PSP's own time.
